body.x: Chairman and CEO of IBM, Ginni Rometty, will open the door to CES 2019 as a keynote speaker. Rometty's keynote will be held at the Venetian Palazzo Ballroom in Las Vegas on Tuesday, January 8, 2018, at 8:30 am.

Rometty, who was appointed as IBM's first female CEO in 2012, dismissed other businesses with high-end server mainframes, among other hardware sales and maintenance businesses, including servers. Later, Rometty focused on improving cloud services, AI, and block chain technology, which she chose as a strategic business. Data, cyber security, and cloud companies, but sales of existing businesses continued to decline and new businesses grew slower.

The CEO did not give up, and IBM continued research on artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and quantum. As a result, IBM succeeded in becoming the first company to build its first 50-qubit prototype processor, and a quantum computer (IBM Q) that enables companies, researchers, and developers to explore their use in real business and scientific applications. IBM's quantum computer uses a qubit that has both 0s and 1s and processes it in parallel, boasting a higher speed and superior performance than a supercomputer.

In addition, IBM has been attracting attention in the industry on October 8, 2018 with the launch of Food Trust, a block chain-based food distribution tracking network. This service is a digital public transaction book that transparently records transaction details on a book that anyone can read, and duplicates it on multiple computers and stores it. Because the distribution process of all the products is recorded, the problem can be solved quickly when a defect is found in a specific product. 'Food trust' seems to be able to solve misunderstandings of the public who think 'block chain is cryptocurrency'.
The platform has been recognized for its performance by signing contracts with large retailers such as Wal-Mart and Carrefour, bringing IBM to a new heyday.

At the heart of IBM emerging as a leader in solving global challenges by deploying cutting-edge technology and responsibly, CEO Rometty was recognized as the world's most influential 50 selected by Bloomberg, Fortune's 50 most powerful women in business, the most important technology of TIME.

CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition, will be launched from Tuesday 8 January 2019 to Thursday 11 November 2019 in Las Vegas, Nevada, where IBM CEO Ginni Rometty will announce the opening keynote address. CES is a global event for everyone in the technology industry and a high-level business event that encompasses a wide range of industries.

On the other hand, AVING NEWS, the media company that is most passionate about advertising Korean companies in the world, is planning to launch the CES 2019 start-up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT as a project to help domestic start-ups to advance into the global market. Considering the advantages of CES, which is not a traditional joint venture, it plans to expose promising start-ups to investors, businesses and media through a variety of programs including participation strategy consulting, public relations marketing, and networking parties. Particularly, on the third evening of the exhibition, the company plans to hold a 'MIK NIGHT' party, a business networking party, inviting investors and media that companies have met.
MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT is jointly planned and operated by AVING NEWS and Global MICE Expert Group, GMEG.
